## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important

Attributes `is_local`, `vpn_url`, `local_url` are not provided anymore for camera entities.
`rf_status_lvl` and `wifi_status_lvl` diagnostics sensors are dropped.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Pyatmo got a major refactoring to lead the way to support more devices from more manufacturers after Netatmo published their new API. 

Netatmo Smart Modulating Thermostat and Smart Video Doorbell are now also supported.

Support for more devices will be added in separate PRs, so this will only ensure all current functionality maintained.

Release: https://github.com/jabesq/pyatmo/releases/tag/v7.0.1
Changelog: https://github.com/jabesq/pyatmo/blob/v7.0.1/CHANGELOG.md

issue_context.title: Netatmo integration and battery entity
issue_context.body:
### The problem

thermo valves imported in my Hassio using the integration. when you made the configuration the integration at the early beginning, all the devices and entities are available. once you make a restart of the hassio, all the batteries entities become unavailable. to get them back, you have to delete the integration and make it again. But again in case of restart of hassio the battery entities become unavailable:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64804254/148789383-19f3f470-8cd6-4edd-a552-c789b85e4148.png)





### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2021.12.8

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

Home Assistant 2021.12.7  but the entity did now exist. battery level (not % but txt type) was an attribute

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

netatmo 

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/netatmo/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
